title: Greer briefed Clinton's CIA director

tellings.quote: 93 94 95 I briefed the CIA director for Clinton in December 13th of 93

plain: Steven Greer, a campaigner who says UFO secrets are held by a hidden global group, says he personally briefed President Bill Clinton's director of the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, on 13 December 1993 in Washington. He tells it as his own experience, part of a run of meetings he places in 1993, 1994 and 1995. If true, it would mean the UFO question reached the top of American intelligence in the early Clinton years.
